describes: The LLM judge prompts used to build the tiers, stage 7. Transcribed verbatim from the prompt library and the hq_10000 filter configuration that produced the gold tier. Shipped so the judges can be re-run and so the prompts are readable without running anything.

model.name: qwen3.5:35b
model.note: Quantised Qwen3.5 35B, served by Ollama. The paper ran it on four NVIDIA Titan V/Xp cards.

system_prompts.boolean: Never provide a preamble like sure, of course. Do not provide an explanation. Always answer with "Yes" or "No", nothing else.

messy_streets_similar_street_1.name: Address validation: are the streets similar

messy_streets_contains_pid_2.name: Address validation: is there personaly identifiable information in the address
messy_streets_contains_pid_2.methodology: Attempt to reduce false positives by allowing streets named after notable people

messy_streets_is_missing_1.name: Address validation: is the data missing?

messy_streets_is_valid_street_1.name: Address validation: is the street a valid street address?

messy_streets_is_valid_country_1.name: Address validation: is the country a valid country?
